value.doc: Unique non-empty value reported by active_change and action.

label.doc: Required searchable/accessibility text; content may replace its visual label.

content.doc: Rich visual label; ranking and accessible name still use label.

hint.doc: Inline secondary text, also searched with keyword precedence.

icon.doc: Non-interactive glyph node or logical asset ID; the leading slot is reserved when empty.

logo.doc: Non-interactive logo node or logical asset ID on a tile; takes precedence over icon.

keywords.doc: Additional search terms with keyword precedence.

group.doc: Heading; groups preserve first matching source order.

shortcut.doc: Row-end shortcut legend overriding a registered action binding.

action.doc: Registered action dispatched on activation; its enabled state and shortcut are inherited.

disabled.doc: Dimmed and excluded from activation and navigation.
